correctness.rationale: On H^2_0, C_{z^p} C_{z^q}* maps e_{qk} to e_{pk} if both degrees <=N; every component is a directed path since p≠q and it is a partial permutation. With g=gcd(p,q), a=p/g, b=q/g and M=max(a,b), j-step paths are precisely e_{g b^j s}→e_{g a^j s}, 1<=s<=floor(N/(gM^j)), yielding rank r_j=floor(N/(gM^j)). Its second differences determine orthogonal unweighted Jordan block multiplicities, so all cutoffs are unitarily equivalent to zero padding plus truncated C_{z^M} on L=floor(N/g). Symmetrized k-block eigenvalues are cos(j pi/(k+1)); geometric block tails give pure-point weak limit with dense support. Longest block gives disk numerical radius cos(pi/(J_N+2)) and log-square edge constant pi²(log M)²/2. Independently enumerated all path profiles for seven varied (p,q,N) examples including noncoprime and reversed pairs; finite tests only corroborate.
